title: Structural Genomics Defines PBRM1 Bromodomain Variant Function in ccRCC.
authors: Bursch, Karina L; Jorge, Salomao D; Catlin, Audrey E; Nunez, Raymundo; LeClaire, Michael D; Licklider, Jacob; Urrutia, Raul A; Smith, Brian C
one_liner_zh: 该文用结构基因组学与分子动力学评估PBRM1溴结构域错义变异对乙酰赖氨酸结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模。
abstract: Polybromo-1 (PBRM1) modulates chromatin accessibility and transcription via six bromodomains that bind acetyl-lysine residues on nuclear proteins. PBRM1 variants exist in ~40% of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) cases. PBRM1 loss correlates with improved responses to antiangiogenics and immune checkpoint blockade, which are the standard of care for ccRCC therapy. Missense variants cluster within PBRM1 bromodomains and are present in 16% of ccRCC cases, with unknown impacts on therapeutic response. Since in-depth biophysical and cellular testing of the hundreds of PBRM1 missense variants reported in ccRCC and other cancer types is intractable, computational approaches can provide actionable variant impact assessments. We employed an integrated structural genomics analysis at the levels of protein sequence (2D), structure (3D), and molecular dynamics (4D) to evaluate the effects of all reported ccRCC-associated missense variants in the second and fourth bromodomains of PBRM1 (33 total) on molecular fitness (i.e., stability, structural integrity, and ligand binding). We also evaluated the concordance between molecular fitness and biophysical parameters of variant structural integrity (differential scanning fluorimetry, circular dichroism, and (1)H-NMR spectroscopy) and ligand binding (AlphaScreen and electrophoretic mobility shift assays). Integrated molecular fitness scores correlated with measures of acetylated histone binding, while 3D and integrated molecular fitness scores correlated with measures of thermal stability. This integrated structural genomics analysis accelerates mechanistic understanding of how ccRCC missense variants impact PBRM1 bromodomain structure and function. This knowledge supports future studies correlating specific missense variants with PBRM1 tumor-suppressive functions and patient responses to antiangiogenics and immune checkpoint blockade to inform ccRCC personalized medicine approaches.
abstract_zh: Polybromo-1（PBRM1）通过六个溴结构域（bromodomains）调节染色质可及性和转录，这些溴结构域结合核蛋白上的乙酰赖氨酸残基。PBRM1变异存在于约40%的透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）病例中。PBRM1缺失与对抗血管生成药物和免疫检查点阻断（ccRCC治疗的标准方案）的改善反应相关。错义变异聚集在PBRM1溴结构域内，存在于16%的ccRCC病例中，其对治疗反应的影响未知。由于对ccRCC及其他癌症类型中报道的数百种PBRM1错义变异进行深入的生物物理和细胞测试难以实现，计算方法可提供可操作的变异影响评估。我们采用了一种整合的结构基因组学分析，涵盖蛋白质序列（2D）、结构（3D）和分子动力学（4D）水平，以评估所有已报道的ccRCC相关错义变异在PBRM1第二和第四溴结构域（共33个）对分子适应性（即稳定性、结构完整性和配体结合）的影响。我们还评估了分子适应性与变异结构完整性的生物物理参数（差示扫描荧光法、圆二色谱法和(1)H-NMR光谱法）以及配体结合（AlphaScreen和电泳迁移率变动分析）之间的一致性。整合的分子适应性评分与乙酰化组蛋白结合的测量相关，而3D和整合的分子适应性评分与热稳定性的测量相关。这项整合的结构基因组学分析加速了对ccRCC错义变异如何影响PBRM1溴结构域结构和功能的机制理解。这一知识支持未来研究，将特定错义变异与PBRM1肿瘤抑制功能及患者对抗血管生成药物和免疫检查点阻断的反应相关联，为ccRCC个性化医疗方法提供信息。
